mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_order (order_no, cost_id, uid, amount, pay_channel, status, create_time, expire_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{costId}, #{uid}, #{amount}, #{payChannel}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{expireTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payment_order WHERE cost_id = #{costId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_order SET status = 2 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payment_order WHERE uid = #{uid} ORDER BY create_time DESC
